profile.summary: RRIL Limited, together with its subsidiary, manufactures and trades in textile products in India. It operates through Textiles and Real Estate Development segments. The company also develops residential, commercial, retail, and social infrastructure projects, as well as engages in the redevelopment of housing projects.
